Lightning Damage is one of the Damage Types, it is mitigated by Lightning Protection, Elemental Protection, and Block Protection.

## Contents

- 1 Known Modifiers

- 1.1 Character Stats

- 1.2 Affixes

- 1.3 Equipment Implicits

- 2 List of Lightning Damage Skills

- 2.1 NPC

## Known Modifiers[]

### Character Stats[]

- Increased Lightning Damage

- Increased Elemental Damage

- Attunement (as a result of increasing elemental damage)

### Affixes[]

- Added Melee Lightning Damage (only effects Melee Attack Skills)

- Increased Lightning Damage

### Equipment Implicits[]

- Arch Mage Wand and its variants provide added lightning damage to spells

- Storm Priest Wand provides added spell lightning damage

- Lagonian Axe provides added melee lightning damage

- Lagonian Hammer provides increased lightning damage

- Warding Tome provides increased lightning damage

- Copper Ring provides increased lightning damage
